units.rawText: Eucharist's body gradually grows transparent, dissipating in the air and into data.
units.displayText: Eucharist's body gradually grows transparent, dissipating in the air and into data.

spans.text: Eucharist's body gradually grows transparent, dissipating in the air and into data.

units.rawText: The area, having gone through two battles, is now a ruin. Only Clukay and I are left.
units.displayText: The area, having gone through two battles, is now a ruin. Only Clukay and I are left.

spans.text: The area, having gone through two battles, is now a ruin. Only Clukay and I are left.

units.rawText: Isn't this a bit overkill?
units.displayText: Isn't this a bit overkill?

spans.text: Isn't this a bit overkill?

units.rawText: You have to pull them out by the roots. At least for a bit, those Sanctifiers won't come back looking for us.
units.displayText: You have to pull them out by the roots. At least for a bit, those Sanctifiers won't come back looking for us.

spans.text: You have to pull them out by the roots. At least for a bit, those Sanctifiers won't come back looking for us.

units.rawText: Besides, going by the style of a certain someone, there'd be no mercy at times like these.
units.displayText: Besides, going by the style of a certain someone, there'd be no mercy at times like these.

spans.text: Besides, going by the style of a certain someone, there'd be no mercy at times like these.

units.rawText: By that tone, I assume your memories are back?
units.displayText: By that tone, I assume your memories are back?

spans.text: By that tone, I assume your memories are back?

units.rawText: Back is perhaps a bit of an understatement. I'd rather forget this period of roleplaying with you here in the cloud.
units.displayText: Back is perhaps a bit of an understatement. I'd rather forget this period of roleplaying with you here in the cloud.

spans.text: Back is perhaps a bit of an understatement. I'd rather forget this period of roleplaying with you here in the cloud.

units.rawText: Haha... In good spirits, I see.
units.displayText: Haha... In good spirits, I see.

spans.text: Haha... In good spirits, I see.

units.rawText: Anyhow. Professor... or Commander? How should I refer to you?
units.displayText: Anyhow. Professor... or Commander? How should I refer to you?

spans.text: Anyhow. Professor... or Commander? How should I refer to you?

units.rawText: Since we're not back to reality yet, "Professor" will do, at least while we're in Magrasea.
units.displayText: Since we're not back to reality yet, "Professor" will do, at least while we're in Magrasea.

spans.text: Since we're not back to reality yet, "Professor" will do, at least while we're in Magrasea.

units.rawText: Just like you're here under the codename of "Clukay". These experiences aren't bad, right?
units.displayText: Just like you're here under the codename of "Clukay". These experiences aren't bad, right?

spans.text: Just like you're here under the codename of "Clukay". These experiences aren't bad, right?

units.rawText: Looks like you've heard none of what I just said.
units.displayText: Looks like you've heard none of what I just said.

spans.text: Looks like you've heard none of what I just said.

units.rawText: The post-fusion Clukay sighs, showing me a familiar smile, yet different from the her before.
units.displayText: The post-fusion Clukay sighs, showing me a familiar smile, yet different from the her before.

spans.text: The post-fusion Clukay sighs, showing me a familiar smile, yet different from the her before.

units.rawText: Truth be told, it's all a bit chaotic. Both sets of memories are here. Some I don't know if I should file under 416, or Clukay...
units.displayText: Truth be told, it's all a bit chaotic. Both sets of memories are here. Some I don't know if I should file under 416, or Clukay...

spans.text: Truth be told, it's all a bit chaotic. Both sets of memories are here. Some I don't know if I should file under 416, or Clukay...

units.rawText: Both, because they're both you. You feel it, right? Same moods, same desires.
units.displayText: Both, because they're both you. You feel it, right? Same moods, same desires.

spans.text: Both, because they're both you. You feel it, right? Same moods, same desires.

units.rawText: As I see it, you just briefly returned to the newly started state... A fresh perspective of the world, and of me.
units.displayText: As I see it, you just briefly returned to the newly started state... A fresh perspective of the world, and of me.

spans.text: As I see it, you just briefly returned to the newly started state... A fresh perspective of the world, and of me.

units.rawText: It's like I've gotten to know you again, like I've looked into... a new possibility.
units.displayText: It's like I've gotten to know you again, like I've looked into... a new possibility.

spans.text: It's like I've gotten to know you again, like I've looked into... a new possibility.

units.rawText: Hmph...
units.displayText: Hmph...

spans.text: Hmph...

units.rawText: She nods, neither confirming nor denying my words.
units.displayText: She nods, neither confirming nor denying my words.

spans.text: She nods, neither confirming nor denying my words.

units.rawText: In any case, I'm tired. Let's go rest at the Admin Center.
units.displayText: In any case, I'm tired. Let's go rest at the Admin Center.

spans.text: In any case, I'm tired. Let's go rest at the Admin Center.

units.rawText: Of course... Hm? Clukay?
units.displayText: Of course... Hm? Clukay?

spans.text: Of course... Hm? Clukay?

units.rawText: Clukay, about to take a step once more, suddenly stumbles.
units.displayText: Clukay, about to take a step once more, suddenly stumbles.

spans.text: Clukay, about to take a step once more, suddenly stumbles.

units.rawText: Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

units.rawText: Clukay! Are you alright, Clukay?
units.displayText: Clukay! Are you alright, Clukay?

spans.text: Clukay! Are you alright, Clukay?

units.rawText: I didn't think... it'd come around this fast...
units.displayText: I didn't think... it'd come around this fast...

spans.text: I didn't think... it'd come around this fast...

units.rawText: This fast? You knew it was coming, Clukay?
units.displayText: This fast? You knew it was coming, Clukay?

spans.text: This fast? You knew it was coming, Clukay?

units.rawText: In my arms, Clukay's arm is already tinted purple.
units.displayText: In my arms, Clukay's arm is already tinted purple.

spans.text: In my arms, Clukay's arm is already tinted purple.

units.rawText: The beginning of Entropization.
units.displayText: The beginning of Entropization.

spans.text: The beginning of Entropization.

units.rawText: Persicaria? Still here?
units.displayText: Persicaria? Still here?

spans.text: Persicaria? Still here?

units.rawText: If I don't go out, I can watch you for an entire day. <size=28>I'm not working anyway...</size>
units.displayText: If I don't go out, I can watch you for an entire day. I'm not working anyway...

spans.text: If I don't go out, I can watch you for an entire day.
I'm not working anyway...

units.rawText: Entropization is...
units.displayText: Entropization is...

spans.text: Entropization is...

units.rawText: The virus' influence is spreading.
units.displayText: The virus' influence is spreading.

spans.text: The virus' influence is spreading.

units.rawText: Judging by the symptoms, she must've been enduring this for a while.
units.displayText: Judging by the symptoms, she must've been enduring this for a while.

spans.text: Judging by the symptoms, she must've been enduring this for a while.

units.rawText: This... is nothing...
units.displayText: This... is nothing...

spans.text: This... is nothing...

units.rawText: So that's why you were making every second count against Eucharist.
units.displayText: So that's why you were making every second count against Eucharist.

spans.text: So that's why you were making every second count against Eucharist.

units.rawText: I just wanted to... Clear the way for the Professor...
units.displayText: I just wanted to... Clear the way for the Professor...

spans.text: I just wanted to... Clear the way for the Professor...

units.rawText: If this continues, I'll become like before the fusion...
units.displayText: If this continues, I'll become like before the fusion...

spans.text: If this continues, I'll become like before the fusion...

units.rawText: That feels really terrible, like your neural cloud isn't your own anymore...
units.displayText: That feels really terrible, like your neural cloud isn't your own anymore...

spans.text: That feels really terrible, like your neural cloud isn't your own anymore...

units.rawText: Clukay...
units.displayText: Clukay...

spans.text: Clukay...

units.rawText: ...Sorry, Professor.
units.displayText: ...Sorry, Professor.

spans.text: ...Sorry, Professor.

units.rawText: Does this count... as a failed mission?
units.displayText: Does this count... as a failed mission?

spans.text: Does this count... as a failed mission?

units.rawText: No, not yet! Persicaria, do you have any ideas?
units.displayText: No, not yet! Persicaria, do you have any ideas?

spans.text: No, not yet! Persicaria, do you have any ideas?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, we have too little research into Entropy.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, we have too little research into Entropy.

spans.text: Unfortunately, we have too little research into Entropy.

units.rawText: If we could have gathered the medical Dolls of the Neural Cloud Sector earlier and constructed some sort of medical department, perhaps there'd be treatment available.
units.displayText: If we could have gathered the medical Dolls of the Neural Cloud Sector earlier and constructed some sort of medical department, perhaps there'd be treatment available.

spans.text: If we could have gathered the medical Dolls of the Neural Cloud Sector earlier and constructed some sort of medical department, perhaps there'd be treatment available.

units.rawText: But in our current condition we do not have the means to effectively remove the virus.
units.displayText: But in our current condition we do not have the means to effectively remove the virus.

spans.text: But in our current condition we do not have the means to effectively remove the virus.

units.rawText: Then...
units.displayText: Then...

spans.text: Then...

units.rawText: Well, I do have an idea.
units.displayText: Well, I do have an idea.

spans.text: Well, I do have an idea.

units.rawText: What is it?
units.displayText: What is it?

spans.text: What is it?

units.rawText: Do you remember how you guys appeared in my office?
units.displayText: Do you remember how you guys appeared in my office?

spans.text: Do you remember how you guys appeared in my office?

units.rawText: You mean...
units.displayText: You mean...

spans.text: You mean...

units.rawText: You came from outside of the cloud. Seeing as that's the case... return to from whence thou cam'st.
units.displayText: You came from outside of the cloud. Seeing as that's the case... return to from whence thou cam'st.

spans.text: You came from outside of the cloud. Seeing as that's the case... return to from whence thou cam'st.

units.rawText: I understand. We forcibly log out, and reset the data to before we came to Magrasea.
units.displayText: I understand. We forcibly log out, and reset the data to before we came to Magrasea.

spans.text: I understand. We forcibly log out, and reset the data to before we came to Magrasea.

units.rawText: Smart. A virus that only exists in the cloud can theoretically be reset during the logout process, like high-temperature disinfection.
units.displayText: Smart. A virus that only exists in the cloud can theoretically be reset during the logout process, like high-temperature disinfection.

spans.text: Smart. A virus that only exists in the cloud can theoretically be reset during the logout process, like high-temperature disinfection.

units.rawText: But if we do that, this operation...
units.displayText: But if we do that, this operation...

spans.text: But if we do that, this operation...

units.rawText: It'll be a failure, and our memories from here will be gone as well.
units.displayText: It'll be a failure, and our memories from here will be gone as well.

spans.text: It'll be a failure, and our memories from here will be gone as well.

units.rawText: But so what?
units.displayText: But so what?

spans.text: But so what?

units.rawText: Professor...?
units.displayText: Professor...?

spans.text: Professor...?

units.displayText: Entropization must hurt. I'd rather not have Clukay go through it again.

spans.text: Entropization must hurt. I'd rather not have Clukay go through it again.

units.rawText: Clukay, what do you think?
units.displayText: Clukay, what do you think?

spans.text: Clukay, what do you think?

units.rawText: Just speak your mind.
units.displayText: Just speak your mind.

spans.text: Just speak your mind.

units.rawText: ...I'm here, because you are here.
units.displayText: ...I'm here, because you are here.

spans.text: ...I'm here, because you are here.

units.rawText: If I cannot continue to protect you... then there's no meaning.
units.displayText: If I cannot continue to protect you... then there's no meaning.

spans.text: If I cannot continue to protect you... then there's no meaning.

units.rawText: You're becoming more straightforward, Clukay.
units.displayText: You're becoming more straightforward, Clukay.

spans.text: You're becoming more straightforward, Clukay.

units.rawText: Must be your imagination then, seeing as we just fought alongside each other...
units.displayText: Must be your imagination then, seeing as we just fought alongside each other...

spans.text: Must be your imagination then, seeing as we just fought alongside each other...

units.rawText: Yeah, trusting someone else with everything you have. Feels nice, doesn't it?
units.displayText: Yeah, trusting someone else with everything you have. Feels nice, doesn't it?

spans.text: Yeah, trusting someone else with everything you have. Feels nice, doesn't it?

units.displayText: I suppose, yeah.
